records.evidence_sentence: - b) Groundwater Levels :  In  August  2025,  In  Post-monsoon 2025, around 90% of the country's monitoring stations exhibited a depth to water level within 10 meters below ground level. Deeper  water  levels  of  more  than  20  m  are  observed  in  around  5%  of  stations  of  the country  covering  mainly  the  western  states,  especially  Western  Rajasthan,  Punjab, Haryana and Chandigarh.

records.pests: The Deeper Groundwater Level In The States Like Western Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana And Chandigarh  During  Post-Monsoon  2025  Has  Been  Significantly  Influenced  By  The  Over Extraction Of Groundwater Compared To The Recharge During The Monsoon Period

records.evidence_sentence: The  Groundwater  Drought  Indices  indicate  that  in Post-monsoon  2025 ,  groundwater conditions  across  India  remained  largely  stable,  with 91%  of  monitoring  stations showing no  deficit .  However,  localized  deficits  were  observed  in  several  regions  notably in Meghalaya, Nagaland, and the Dadar Nagar Havili & Daman & Diu.
